title: Decision
description: A human decision record recording intent for an observed behavior difference.

run_id.description: UUID of the run that produced this decision

repository.description: Remote origin URL of the repository

file_path.description: Repository-relative path to the file containing the changed function

base_commit.description: Full SHA of the base commit

head_commit.description: Full SHA of the head commit

probe_file.description: Repository-relative path to the probe file

probe_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of probe file bytes

observed_before.description: Observed output on the base revision (any JSON value)

observed_after.description: Observed output on the head revision (any JSON value)

verdict.description: Human decision on whether the difference was intentional

rationale.description: Non-empty string when verdict is intended; may be empty for other verdicts

status.description: Always written as proposed; approval is derived from git reachability on the default branch

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this decision was recorded
